context.transcript:
I called this meeting to update you on the timeline to deliver the auto-check software we've been developing for our client SuperSpeed Automotive.
Next week, a representative from SuperSpeed will visit our office to see a preview and ask questions.
SuperSpeed wants to ensure the software includes all the requested functionalities.
By the middle of June, a select number of SuperSpeed employees will begin using a beta version and they will report their experience by the end of July.
Finally, we will work on software repairs to address any issues that the client encountered throughout August and roll out the final product at the end of August.
context.transcript_translation:
我召集这次会议是为了向大家更新我们正在为客户 SuperSpeed Automotive 开发的自动检查软件的时间表。
下周，SuperSpeed 的一位代表将访问我们的办公室进行预览并提出问题。
SuperSpeed 希望确保该软件包含所有要求的功能。
到六月中旬，一定数量的 SuperSpeed 员工将开始使用测试版，并在七月底前报告他们的体验。
最后，我们将在八月期间修复软件以解决客户遇到的任何问题，并在八月底推出最终产品。
